title: KOSPI Close November 16, 2026: Falls 3.59% to 5,100.50, KOSDAQ -4.86%
content:
KOSPI closed at 5,100.50, down 3.59%, and KOSDAQ closed at 665.65, down 4.86%, after both opened higher and reversed as U.S. chip stocks fell, investors turned cautious ahead of Nvidia's earnings and foreign investors sold. Security, detection and camera stocks surged after reports of AI-assisted cheating at the tax accountant exam.

IndexCloseChange
KOSPI5,100.50-3.59%

1. Both indexes reverse from higher opens

KOSPI opened at 5,305.40 (+0.28%) and reached 5,327.99, then fell as far as 5,069.83 (-4.17%) before closing at 5,100.50. KOSDAQ opened at 705.88 (+0.89%), touched 708.34 and dropped as low as 664.98 (-4.95%), closing at 665.65.

Korean market coverage pointed to a drop in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, caution ahead of Nvidia's earnings report and foreign selling. Samsung Electronics fell 4.47% and SK hynix 7.89%.

On KOSPI, foreign investors net sold about 1.38 trillion won and institutions about 451 billion won, while individuals net bought about 1.34 trillion won (provisional). On KOSDAQ, foreigners net sold about 210 billion won and institutions about 154 billion won, while individuals net bought about 377 billion won.

2. Exam cheating scandal — security, detection and camera stocks

Reports that a tax accountant exam was targeted by cheating with a tiny camera and generative AI raised hopes for stronger exam-hall security and more demand for electronic device detection and video surveillance. Names in radio-wave and hidden-camera detection, video AI and camera modules rose.

3. Smart glasses

As devices combining tiny cameras and AI drew attention, smart glasses suppliers saw buying: Sapien Semiconductors (micro LED display driver chips), LaonTek (AR/VR microdisplays) and Newflex (flexible printed circuits for wearables).

4. Alzheimer's drug hopes — Aribio AR1001

Aribio-related stocks drew buying on reports that the company received topline data from its global phase 3 trial of AR1001, an oral Alzheimer's drug candidate. Receiving data is not the same as a successful trial or approval, so official results need to be confirmed.

Quick FAQ

How did KOSPI and KOSDAQ close on Nov 16?
KOSPI closed at 5,100.50 (-3.59%) and KOSDAQ at 665.65 (-4.86%). Both opened higher, then reversed; intraday lows were -4.17% and -4.95%.

Why did Korean stocks fall?
A reported drop in U.S. chip stocks, caution ahead of Nvidia's earnings and heavy foreign selling hit large chip names such as Samsung Electronics and SK hynix.

Why did security and detection stocks surge?
Reports of AI-assisted cheating at the tax accountant exam raised hopes for more exam-hall security and device-detection demand.
